import pandas as pd, glob, os
out={}
for f in glob.glob('airlines/*.csv'):
 c=os.path.basename(f)[:2]; d=pd.read_csv(f).drop_duplicates('flight_id').copy()
 # identify columns suffix
 sc='sched_dep_utc' if 'sched_dep_utc' in d else 'sched_dep'; ac='actual_dep_utc' if 'actual_dep_utc' in d else 'actual_dep'
 d['route']=d.apply(lambda r:'-'.join(sorted([r.origin,r.dest])),axis=1)
 d['delay']=pd.to_timedelta(d[ac].fillna('00:00')+':00').dt.total_seconds()/60-pd.to_timedelta(d[sc]+':00').dt.total_seconds()/60
 # overnight correction for completed earlier actual
 d.loc[(~d.cancelled)&(d.delay< -720),'delay']+=1440
 g=d.groupby('route').agg(scheduled=('flight_id','size'), completed=('cancelled',lambda x:(~x).sum()), delayed=('delay',lambda x:((x>15)&x.notna()).sum()))
 g['rate']=g.delayed/g.completed
 busy=g[g.scheduled==g.scheduled.max()]
 eligible=g[g.completed>=20]; worst=eligible[eligible.rate==eligible.rate.max()]
 print('\n',c,'rows',len(d),'busy max',busy.to_dict('index'),'worst',worst.to_dict('index'))
 print('all eligible sorted'); print(eligible.sort_values(['rate','completed'],ascending=False).head(10))
 out[c]={'busiest':busy.index[0],'worst':worst.index[0]}
print(out)

events.notes: Loaded each carrier file, deduplicated repeated flight_id records (B6 had duplicates), normalized each route by alphabetically sorting its two airport codes, and counted all remaining scheduled flights for busiest. Computed completed-flight delays from actual minus scheduled time (adding a day for completed flights crossing midnight), then selected the highest delayed/completed rate among routes with at least 20 completed flights.
